cards.title: Always use all 30 audit subagents — none idle
cards.rationale: Owner standing instruction: every audit wave fans out all 30 lanes so no domain layer escapes review and no lane sits idle while others run — maximizes defect discovery throughput per audit pass.

cards.title: Wave-6: 30-lane all-domain zero-flaw audit
cards.description: User directive: one-stop all-in-one FP&A for ALL industries, zero compromises/flaws. Fan out 30 read-only audit subagents across every layer (engines/stores/pages/UI/workers/services/plugins/security/Tauri/server/i18n/a11y/perf/e2e/build/docs/product-gap). Output: severity-ranked findings with file:line evidence, synthesized report + P0 fix queue.
cards.summary: DONE 2026-08-24: 30/30 lanes reported across three orchestration passes. Registered 16 unique P0 / 99 P1 / 62 P2 findings with file:line witnesses. Deliverables: docs/audit/WAVE6_ZERO_FLAW_AUDIT_2026-08-24.md (P0 register + P1 clusters + sound-foundations list), reports/WAVE6_WORKFLOW_RAW_2026-08-24.txt (raw archive), reasoning-ledger Entry #38, Wave-7 fix card queued. Honest label: docs-truth lane detail lost to spill truncation; solo re-run subagent dispatched (a4274afd). 5 owner decisions flagged in report §OWNER-DECISIONS.
cards.rationale: Owner directive demanded zero-compromise verification; read-only fan-out maximizes evidence throughput inside the locked BMAD path without touching code.
cards.rejected: Single-pass orchestration was tried and lost: schema-structured output failed on 11/30 agents concentrated in large-inventory lanes (engines 530 files, ui 252 files). Fixed by three-pass fan-out (19 main + 5 retry + 6 recovery) with narrowed scopes and plain-text JSON-parse fallback, recovering 30/30 lanes.

cards.title: Acquire useful DSH plugin-market plugins (bulk curated install)
cards.description: Sweep awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog (2016 entries → 1814 unique root-repo candidates), classify with 30 parallel subagents over .market-acquire/slice-*.txt, bulk-install KEEP plugins into profile web via dsh plugin add. Pilot validated (dsh-project-memory). Full KEEP manifest persisted even if install set is capped for stability.
cards.rationale: Owner earlier directed bulk-curated acquisition of DSH plugin-market tools to extend harness capability; pilot validated (dsh-project-memory), KEEP manifest persisted. Deprioritized behind the FinPlan Pro completion mission whenever shell time is contended.

cards.title: Wave-7: P0 fix program (16 defects, 4 batches)
cards.description: Four-batch P0 program COMPLETE + P1 perf tier closed. 7A 3ebf4344 / 7B 5c83551b / 7C 585ca55f / 7D 74c5adfd (128 files, ~99 selector rewrites, worker progress revived, periodClose canonicalized; FULL suite 1298 files/15053 tests executed - all failures repaired to green; ledger #42). Docs batch 993713da (claims gate 11/11). REMAINING: owner-gated bucket only (5 rulings incl P0-05 escrow) + next actionable P1 tiers: a11y cluster (~10), marketplace install integrity, worker plugin isolation.
cards.summary: All four batches closed failing-test-first with gates green: 7A wrong-numbers ×8 (3ebf4344), 7B security ×4+P1s (5c83551b), 7C integration-truth/menu/confirm (585ca55f), 7D perf sweep ~200 selector-less subscriptions + worker progress revived + periodClose canonicalized (74c5adfd), docs claims gate 11/11 (993713da). Full suite milestone: 1298 files / 15053 tests executed, all failures triaged & repaired; final gates tsc 0 / eslint 0 / build 0. Ledger Entries #39–#42.
cards.rationale: Wave-6 register held 16 unique P0 defects that made the product unshippable against the zero-compromise mandate; batching by risk class (wrong-numbers → security → integration-truth → product-surface/perf) let each commit land verifiable green gates instead of one untestable mega-change.
cards.rejected: One mega-fix commit rejected — unreviewable and gate-blind. Auto-fixing without failing-test-first rejected — no regression proof. Leaving owner-gated items (key escrow, vault model, server-auth scope, browser-vs-PWA, updater channel) undecided was NOT accepted: they move to the Wave-8 program with documented zero-compromise rulings.
